content.title: Calculators page header opens Open Account
content.intent: Prove that the bank header is present on the Calculators page and that its Open Account link navigates to `/bank-clone-app/open-account`.
content.technique_notes: Used equivalence partitioning over the two named site areas and selected the only outcome-changing navigation path the source states. State-flow techniques were applicable to the click-through navigation, but no additional branches or failure modes were specified. No combinatorial coverage was needed because the path has no independent input dimensions; budget max_pairs=3 did not constrain this scenario set.
